invariants.text: Category.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Category.monthly_budget must be nullable (can be None)
Category.icon must be nullable (can be None)
Expense.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Expense.amount_cents must be a non-negative integer
Expense.description must be a non-null string
Expense.expense_date must be a non-null ISO date string
Expense.category_id must reference an existing Category
Budget.id is an auto-incremented primary key
Budget.category_id must reference an existing Category
Budget.month must be a string in 'YYYY-MM' format and unique for each category per month
Budget.amount_limit_cents must be a non-negative integer
Budget.amount_limit_cents must not exceed the monthly_budget of its Category if provided
